messages.subject: Re: [stan-dev] Re: Developer Info
parts:
We've generally waited until people start contributing pull requests
that get accepted. Not because we're trying to be super exclusive, but
because we get a lot of drive-by contributions from people we never
hear from again, or who submit incomplete pull requests and don't have
the inclination to see it through.

- Bob
